S01.text: Together, blood pressure medicine (lisinopril) and water pill (furosemide) raise the risk in heat. Heat warning for your water pill: in hot weather it can leave you low on water and salt because you also lose fluid by sweating. Watch for dizziness when you stand, very little urine, confusion or a fall. Do not stop it on your own; follow the fluid plan your doctor gave you and stay somewhere cool. Heat warning for your blood-pressure medicine: in hot weather, if you lose a lot of fluid, it can lower your blood pressure and strain your kidneys. Watch for dizziness when you stand, fainting, very little urine, vomiting or diarrhea. Do not stop it on your own; stay somewhere cool. Heat note for your beta blocker: in hot weather it can make dizziness more likely and can hide a racing heart, one of the body's warning signs. Stand up slowly, stay somewhere cool, and watch for dizziness or confusion. Stay within the fluid limit your care team set. If you feel dizzy or very thirsty, call them. Keep taking your medicines as prescribed. Talk to your doctor or pharmacist.
